uplink.description: Grain temperature sensor, Ext=1 (hundredths): channel0 21.46 °C, channel1 21.51 °C
uplink._note: TTN example "Grain Tempearture Sensor" input. Upstream oracle: temperatures [21.46, 21.51], battery 3.669, Ext 1, Systimestamp 1625570502. Each grain channel is now a channels[] entry carrying `temperature`; battery / sensorMode / deviceTime stay top-level. Satisfies temperature.

uplink.description: Ext=1 with a negative channel-2 reading (two's complement)
Ext=2 (tenths): both channels reporting distinct values, channel0 25.0 °C and channel1 -10.0 °C
uplink._note: Synthetic frame exercising the Ext=0x02 tenths scaling on both positions; cross-checked against the upstream decoder (Temp_Channel1 25.0, Temp_Channel2 -10.0). bytes[3..4]=0x00FA=250 -> 25.0 °C; bytes[5..6]=0xFF9C=-100 -> -10.0 °C. No channel word is a sentinel in this format, so both entries are always emitted.

uplink.description: Ext=3 (channel resistance in Ω, not a temperature) returns an error
uplink._note: Resistance mode carries no confident temperature for either channel, so the frame is rejected rather than emitting channels[] entries with a non-temperature value.
